claims.text: Human-AI interaction research themes include collaboration, competition, conflict, and symbiosis.
Human-AI interaction studies draw theoretical foundations from communication, psychology, and sociology.
Human-AI interaction research commonly employs self-reporting and observational approaches in user studies.

evidence.description: HAII research themes include human-AI collaboration, competition, conflict, and symbiosis.
Theories drawn from communication, psychology, and sociology support these studies
the employed methods include both self-reporting and observational approaches commonly utilized in user studies.

methodologies.name: Literature Review
